```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Purpose:**
Analyzes tumor growth over time across experimental groups and generates the tumor growth results presented in the manuscript.

**Inputs:**
1. Tumor Growth Volume excel spreadsheet
  Source: [lab generated thus data are not provided in this repository]
  
**Manuscript Outputs:**
- Figure 4B
- Figure 4C

# Libraries
```{r}
library(knitr)
library(readxl)


```

## File Locations
```{r}
resultsDir1 <- here("data","data_objects")
resultsDir6 <- here("data","tumor_growth")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir6)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir6,recursive = TRUE)
}

pathToVolume <- here("tumor")

```

# Data Preparation
```{r}
EV_loc <- file.path(pathToVolume,"EV_tumor_volume.txt")

data_file <- file.path(pathToVolume,"tumor_volume.xlsx")


if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  data_file <- "/mnt/data/FoxD3 TIL data.xlsx"
}

raw_growth <- read_excel(
  data_file,
  sheet = "Growth -- tumor volumes",
  range = "B2:L8",
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_types = "text"
)

# The first row in this imported range contains mouse labels. Because readxl
# assigns a single type per column, mixed text/numeric columns can otherwise
# remain character and cause pivot_longer() type-combination errors. We
# therefore drop the label row, assign clean names, and explicitly parse every
# measurement column before reshaping.

growth <- raw_growth[-1, ]

names(growth) <- c(
  "Day",
  paste0("EV_", 1:5),
  paste0("FoxD3_", 1:5)
)

parse_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9eE+\\.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}



growth <- growth |>
  mutate(
    Day = parse_num(Day),
    across(-Day, parse_num)
  )

growth_long <- growth |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Day,
    names_to = "Mouse",
    values_to = "Volume",
    values_transform = list(Volume = as.numeric)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Treatment = if_else(grepl("^EV", Mouse), "EV", "FoxD3"),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("EV", "FoxD3")),
    Mouse = factor(Mouse),
    log_volume = if_else(Volume > 0, log(Volume), NA_real_),
    log2_volume = if_else(Volume > 0, log2(Volume), NA_real_)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Day), !is.na(Volume))

growth_long |>
  arrange(Treatment, Mouse, Day) |>
  head(12) |>
  kable(caption = "First rows of long-format tumor-volume data.")

summary_by_day <- growth_long |>
  filter(Day > 0) |>
  group_by(Treatment, Day) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(Volume),
    median = median(Volume),
    sd = sd(Volume),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n),
    min = min(Volume),
    max = max(Volume),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_by_day |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "Tumor-volume summaries by treatment and day.")



```

# Tumor Growth Analysis
```{r}
ggplot(growth_long |> filter(Day > 0),
       aes(x = Day, y = Volume, group = Mouse, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  labs(
    x = "Day",
    y = "Tumor volume",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)


summary_by_day <- ggplot(summary_by_day,
       aes(x = Day, y = mean, color = Treatment, group = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.35) +
  labs(
    x = "Day",
    y = "Mean tumor volume ± SEM",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

ggsave(file.path(resultsDir6,"summary_by_day.png"), summary_by_day,
  width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300, scale = 0.8
)


```

# Day 14 Analysis
```{r}
day14 <- growth_long |>
  filter(Day == 14)

ggplot(day14, aes(x = Treatment, y = Volume, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Tumor volume at day 14"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# let's plot this more fancy


tumor_boxplot <- ggplot(day14, aes(x = Treatment, y = Volume, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Tumor volume at day 14"
  ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11))
  
  
tumor_boxplot_toprint <- tumor_boxplot +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Removes "Time" from the bottom of every plot
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), # Removes "value" from the side of every plot
    strip.background = element_blank(), # Removes those 'bars' if they came back
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(resultsDir6,"day14_boxplot.png"), 
       tumor_boxplot_toprint, width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)


```

```{r}

# convert day 14
day14$group <- rep(1:5, length.out = nrow(day14))

day14_wide <- day14 %>%
  select(group, Treatment, Volume) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = Volume
  )

# calculate p-value
wilcox_exact_p_one_sided <- wilcox.test(
        day14_wide$FoxD3, day14_wide$EV,
        alternative = "greater",
        exact = TRUE)

print(wilcox_exact_p_one_sided)
      
```
